title: What If Everyone on Earth Lived Like Americans?

scenes.text: What if all 8 billion people lived like the average American? We'd need more than five Earths.
Scientists measure this with the ecological footprint: the land and sea needed to supply food, wood and absorb carbon.
The average American's footprint is about 8.1 global hectares. Earth has about 1.6 per person to go around.
Divide one by the other and you get 5.1 Earths.
Right now, humanity already uses nature about 1.7 times faster than the planet can regenerate it.
So the answer is no. It doesn't fit on one planet.
